usefulness_reason: Useful for generic conceptual mathematics because it develops and checks a reusable chain of representation changes: a toric metric cone is encoded by its moment-map image, facet normals encode collapsing circle subgroups, the integer kernel of those normals becomes quotient charges, and the resulting quotient and toric diagram recover geometry and topology. It also distinguishes what quotient descriptions preserve or forget, relates rationality of the Reeb direction to closed versus dense orbits, and uses lattice span, facet count, invariant coordinates, and bundle gluing as complementary structural checks. The physics predictions and explicit p,q formulas are specialized applications rather than the sole source of value.
